description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'PolicyEntryNotModifiableException' used within a policies handling module of a project. The class represents a specific error condition when a policy entry cannot be modified due to insufficient permissions. It includes builder methods, static factory methods, and metadata annotations, indicating its role as a RuntimeException derivative meant for throwing and catching within the application.
